versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkStartOfReception callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as pa- rameters to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_<CGI> call: • info • TpSduLength The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_ <CGI> shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_COM- CbkStartOfReception callback.

When a call to an Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyStartOfRe- ception API exists within an Rte_LdComCbkStartOfReception callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyStartOfReception call: • info • TpSduLength The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyStartOfReception shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_LdComCbkStartOfRe- ception callback.
